component.name: Omarchy Calendar
component.summary: A polished native calendar for Omarchy

description.p: Omarchy Calendar is a keyboard-friendly Qt calendar with offline storage, Google synchronization, event editing, recurring events, invitations, meeting links, and desktop reminders.
It follows the active Omarchy palette and typography while keeping calendar data useful when the network is unavailable.
First stable release with production-approved Google OAuth, offline calendar editing, and Arch and Omarchy packaging.
